description: Net worth, total assets, and total liabilities from comma separated asset and liability values, with optional matching names for the largest asset and liability. Only positive values count, as on the page. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive net worth calculator.

asset_names.description: Asset names, comma separated, in the same order as asset_values.

asset_values.description: Asset values in USD, comma separated, in the same order as asset_names.

liability_names.description: Liability names, comma separated, in the same order as liability_values.

liability_values.description: Liability values in USD, comma separated, in the same order as liability_names.

name: calculate_net_worth
